## Comparison

**Building proportions** — Left is a taller, layered 3/4-view building with a protruding roof slab and recessed entrance. Right is flat/frontal and squatter, more like a wide single block. (Partial match)

**Roofline** — Left has a thick overhanging white roof slab with rooftop boxes and a strong cornice shadow. Right has a thin flat roof with small white boxes, but no overhang or depth. (0.4)

**Window layout** — Left: two rows of blue windows plus corner/side windows, arranged in a grid following the 3D volume. Right: two rows of blue squares, reasonably similar in rhythm and color, though side windows are missing. (0.7)

**Cross plaque** — Left: large dark rounded plaque mounted on the roof center, above the roofline. Right: dark rounded plaque present with white cross, similar size and position. (0.9)

**Door** — Left: dark recessed entrance, centered, tall, framed by white surround with slight depth. Right: dark rounded rectangle, centered but wider and floating without a recess. (0.7)

**Bushes** — Left: clustered green bushes on both sides, right cluster larger. Right: bush clusters on both sides, similar style. Good match. (0.85)

**Shadow** — Left: soft wide shadow under the whole base. Right: narrow subtle shadow only under the middle; sides lack grounding. (0.5)

**Colors** — White building, blue windows, dark charcoal plaque/door, green bushes — all match. (0.9)

## Scores

| Category | Score |
|---|---|
| Silhouette | 0.5 |
| Details | 0.65 |
| Colors | 0.9 |
| **Overall** | **0.65** |

## Brief Fixes
1. **Roofline**: add a thick overhanging roof slab extending past the facade edges; darken its underside for depth.
2. **Proportions**: make the building taller (add vertical height or a second setback tier) and give a subtle 3/4 perspective.
3. **Shadow**: widen and soften the ground shadow to span the full base width.
4. **Door**: add a recessed frame/portal around the dark door instead of a flat rounded rectangle.
5. **Rooftop boxes**: enlarge the white rooftop units so they read behind the plaque.
